acceptance: CLI validates typed args, handles stdout/stderr exit semantics, pins versions and emits parseable structured results.

positive.fixture: typed run over the wire pinning the described digest; one JSON document on stdout, human line on stderr, exit 0

negative.fixture: 28 malformed argument forms refused locally before anything is sent; exit codes follow the taxonomy and are unique per outcome

versions.primitive: CLI grammar v1; legacy vsfctl verify/digest/version unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: Tokens only from the environment or a 0600 file, never a flag; plain http only on loopback; no redirects followed; a lost answer reports effect unknown with the request id to repeat.
known_limitations: No standalone daemon to point the CLI at yet (VSF-B16-T05)
